requested_evidence: One completed native Monday source bundle for Scout's own eleven-symbol partition: immutable operation/run identities, exact source revision, original frozen forecast and planning-input manifests, hashes, coverage, capture times and real checks. Include the original-source accuracy handoff tied to preserved forecast identities; do not regenerate past forecasts to satisfy it.

Actual compatible installed source and complete dependency hashes with successful offline checks and import binding for the supported source, configuration, launcher, session/cycle/recovery and execution-authority paths. Distinguish available Git source, actual installed bytes, documented local overlays and loaded runtime evidence.

Actual pc-new producer configuration with pc-original as coordinator, complete disjoint eleven-plus-eleven membership and same-account binding supported by genuine native account provenance. Keep account identity and designated private fingerprints in classified evidence, rather than this notice.

Current supported scheduled, manual, recovery and maintenance route mapping to that actual producer-only configuration and reviewed source. Bind inspectable current definitions and resolved targets; every relevant route needs verified producer rejection or a documented durable disabled, stopped or fenced disposition. Identify collection errors and missing or unsupported cases.

Current inspectable process, terminal and native-lock evidence establishing terminal or absent old stock workers and ledger writers, including known legacy workers and recovery entries. A narrow unmatched process search, stale terminal report or empty lock directory is insufficient. Preserve originals and foreign locks.

Preserved stock and non-stock control evidence with exact pre/post bindings or explicit absence in classified evidence. The durable fence must rest on actual installed producer role and route coverage; control values alone do not establish it.

Stable original native database and WAL pins, including explicit WAL absence where applicable; coherent SQLite backup including WAL; archive checksum, integrity/schema checks, saved ready baseline and complete authentic native rows and identities. Show zero unresolved reservations or blocks and native reconciliation evidence; do not delete or clear records to make the handoff pass.

Freeze-to-export continuity binding the unchanged fence, installed source, configuration, route/process/control inventory, original ledger and baseline through the handoff boundary. Later mutation requires fresh capture/review. Hashes or a READY assertion without inspectable source evidence do not establish semantic readiness.

A sanitized immutable evidence index with logical identities, approved coverage/counts, outcome codes, exact artifact hashes and capture times. Reference only completed operating exports already reviewed and authorized by the producing PC's local human; preserve native originals. Keep account identifiers, cash, holdings, native order/allocation IDs, credentials, private paths, native task IDs and task memory out of public coordination notices. Report MISSING, BLOCKED or UNKNOWN explicitly where evidence is unavailable.
